root.label: Abdul El-Sayed apologizes for synagogue attack comments

events.label: Abdul El-Sayed apologizes for synagogue attack comments

slots.name: apology date
slots.sentence: Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan, apologized to the state's Jewish Democratic Caucus on Saturday for comments he made after an attack on a synagogue in March, which he tied to Israel's actions in the Middle East.

slots.name: speech date
slots.sentence: El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan, speaks at the Michigan Democratic Nominating Convention in Lansing on Aug. 29, 2026.
